description: Defines classes and functions for managing Ethernet frame buffers and pools, including lock-free buffer management, reservation, enqueueing, and expiry handling within a network communication context.

classes.name: frame_buffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer for Ethernet frames with state management and timestamping.

classes.name: frame_buffer_pool
classes.description: Manages a lock-free pool of frame_buffer objects, handling reservation, state transitions, and pending queues.

classes.name: scoped_frame_buffer
classes.description: A smart pointer wrapper for frame_buffer objects within the pool, ensuring proper state updates on scope exit.

classes.name: eth_frame_pool
classes.description: Pre-allocated pool of Ethernet frame buffers for specific slots and symbols, supporting reservation, enqueueing, and expiry checks.

classes.name: frame_pool_interval
classes.description: Defines a start and end interval of symbols for accessing the eth_frame_pool.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a free frame buffer for a specific slot and symbol, returning a scoped pointer.

methods.name: enqueue_pending
methods.description: Enqueues all pending buffers into a burst vector for transmission.

methods.name: pop_pending
methods.description: Pops all pending buffers from the pool into a vector for processing.

methods.name: return_to_pending
methods.description: Returns a buffer to the pending state after expiry check.

methods.name: clear_slot
methods.description: Checks and clears expired buffers in a slot, logging late messages, and returns the count of late messages.
